# Licences of vendored code

`concaveman.js` combines these npm releases, the ones bundled by the R package concaveman 1.2.0 (`js/concaveman-bundle.js`). Each licence below is the one shipped with that release, except tinyqueue 1.1.0, which declares ISC in its package.json without a licence file; its text is the project's own ISC licence from tinyqueue 1.2.3.
